p.i: putemus ? Tot jam annos, imò lustra, in isdem illis scriptoribus versor, volvo revolvo in easdem curas: malè me hercules de indu-striâ ingenioque nostro sen-tit, quisquis aut non leƈta ea nobis censet, aut negle-Ƈta. Ut è fonte quod hau-rimus, nostrum est, quis-que tamen suo vase : sic quod è communibus illis scriptoribus, sed quisque pro judicii sui modo. Deni-que legere, aut colligere pa-rum est : seligere, dispo-nere, eloqui, poscit laudem.

page.notes: Long s rendered as plain s throughout. The printed "leƈta" and "negleƈta" read as "lecta" and "neglecta" (ct ligature); transcribed as printed. Catchword "Hæc" is at the foot right and is also the start of the next line; it is given once as the catchword and once as the last printed line. Stains and a faint edge of the neighbouring page are not transcribed.
